understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level, completing the current BP35 level and continuing until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: The player moves one tile per directional action while gravity is active and pulls the player in the current direction. Actions consume turns; each attempt has 50 turns and two attempts are available per level. Landing on spikes ends the attempt and restarts the level. The recent actions showed horizontal movement under DOWN gravity, with some ineffective or unregistered movement. No click or undo behavior was observed.
